description:
Request the transcription of a back-catalogue episode: one discovered in its podcast's feed but not yet transcribed, which particle_podcast_list_episodes (transcript_status=requestable, with podcast_slug) and particle_podcast_get_episode mark requestable. Its transcript, segments, speakers, entities and mentions do not exist until it is transcribed.

Billing: the request that queues the episode costs $0.05 per episode on every plan, charged in USD and never drawn from the included requests, and needs overage billing turned on (overage_required otherwise). Confirm the charge with the user before requesting. Every other outcome is billed as an ordinary lookup: an episode your organization already requested (the existing request is returned), one another organization's request already queued, or one we already hold.

It returns at once with the request's state: queued, admitted (being transcribed), transcribed, or failed (failure_reason says why; the charge is refunded). Transcription usually takes 5 to 10 minutes. Poll with particle_podcast_get_transcription_request, which is free; never call this tool again to poll. Once transcribed, the episode keeps its slug and every episode tool serves it: particle_podcast_get_episode, particle_podcast_find_mentions with episode_slug, and particle_podcast_search_transcripts.

episode_slug.description: The episode to transcribe: the episode_slug particle_podcast_list_episodes or particle_podcast_get_episode gives an episode whose transcript is requestable (a back-catalogue episode's is its ID).

name: particle_podcast_request_transcription
title: Particle Podcast Request Transcription
